question.worked_solution:
The table shows probabilities in the form $P(X>x).$ So first, we express the desired probability in this form:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(|X|>x) & =1-P(|X|\le x) \\  & =1-0.99 \\  & =0.01\end{aligned}
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14186989/assets/635de7075b0d106ffc2a0f15e65ca7a3406a49945591aa5eae59090c74df1398.png)

Due to the symmetry of the student's $t$-distribution, we have that $P(|X|>x)=0.01$ is equivalent to

$$
2P(X>x)=0.01\,⟹\,P(X>x)=0.005.
$$

Now, since $X∼{T}_{17},$ we focus on the row of the table that corresponds to $k=17.$

| $k∖p$ | $0.100$ | $0.050$ | $0.025$ | $0.010$ | $0.005$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $15$ | $1.341$ | $1.753$ | $2.131$ | $2.602$ | $2.947$ |
| $16$ | $1.337$ | $1.746$ | $2.120$ | $2.583$ | $2.921$ |
| $17$ | $1.333$ | $1.740$ | $2.110$ | $2.567$ | $2.898$ |

From this row, we see that

$$
P(X\ge 2.898)=0.005.
$$

Therefore, our answer is $x=2.898.$
